estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: When score components were evaluated separately, for every unit increment in the alcohol score, there was 29 % lower risk of obesity-related cancers (HR 0.71, 95 % CI 0.51-0.99) and 49-71 % reduced risk of breast, prostate, and colorectal cancers.
estimate_classifications.reason: The row represents alcohol-score concordance in relation to overall incident prostate cancer. The abstract establishes the prostate cancer analysis, while the supplied full-text evidence provides the row's prostate-specific HR and identifies 153 cases. No aggressive subtype is specified.
